tierReasoning: Native safety-path observation and bounded actor history; no safety decisions changed, but helper identity and permission validation require owner-managed rollout.

guardEvidence.howCaught: The existing desktop-relock-guard-replacement model exercises decideGuardReplacement under sustained pressure and proves the durable maximum of three replacements settles the controller. This change adds passive bounded observation at the existing spawn funnel; it introduces no new trigger, retry, or producer and does not change that production brake.

causalAutopsy.notes: The proof harness had no native lock-dispatch source or complete actor history, so no-lock-call cases remained unmeasured. The new observer closes that evidence gap without changing production safety decisions.
